description: The durable journal of the building module. It holds the successful, the failed and the interrupted attempts and the observed routes. The expert receives a small relevant subset of it; every proposal of the expert is written into it after the local check.

attempt.worldUid: string; the identity of the world; a record of another world is never reused
attempt.method: string; the chosen way of the attempt, for example physical_place, scaffold_place, command_give, expert_repair
attempt.outcome: string; one of confirmed, failed, timeout, cancelled, interrupted, blocked, conflict
attempt.reason: string; the structured reason of the outcome
attempt.plannedRoute: array of {x, y, z}; the cells that were planned to be walked
attempt.actualRoute: array of {x, y, z}; the cells that were really walked; a planned cell that was not walked is not part of it
attempt.routeStatus: string; one of working, blocked, interrupted
attempt.supports: array of {x, y, z, block}; the supports the attempt depended on
attempt.cleanupIds: array of strings; the temporary infrastructure this attempt created

route.cells: array of {x, y, z}; the actually walked cells
route.status: string; one of working, blocked, interrupted
route.supports: array of {x, y, z, block}; the supports the route needed
route.revision: string; the identity of the world snapshot in which the route was walked

expert_decision.outcome: string; one of repair, request_observation, blocked
expert_decision.appliedSteps: array of strings; the ids of the applied steps
expert_decision.source: string; the record of the attempt ledger that the decision used

cleanup_obligation.state_of_obligation: string; one of open, removed, restored, blocked

restoration_obligation.state_of_obligation: string; one of open, restored, skipped, blocked

rules.outcomes: A timeout, a cancellation and a displacement by the defense are different outcomes. A displaced route is not a blocked route.
rules.relevance: Before a replanning the records of the current goal and of the neighbouring routes are selected. A record of another world or of another schema revision is never selected.
rules.deprioritisation: A failed attempt lowers the priority of the same method under unchanged conditions. It does not forbid it forever.
rules.invalidation: A removed support invalidates a recorded success. After a real change of the obstruction a previously failed route may become admissible again.
rules.expert_input: The expert receives a small set of relevant successful and failed attempts; it does not receive the whole journal.
rules.persistence: The journal survives a pause, a stop, a disconnect and a client restart. It is written from an immutable snapshot and the write is atomic.
rules.bounded_size: The trace is bounded. The significant outcomes and the obligations are kept when the trace is shortened.
